name: Weekly store numbers watcher
why: Runs the Monday check on Shopify and GA4 numbers: which to trust, what dropped and the funnel step to fix.

name: Monthly tracking health keeper
why: Monthly hunt for broken tracking and double counts before they reach the weekly report.

name: GA4 store setup checker
why: Checks a store's GA4 set-up for missing day-one settings and ecommerce events.

name: Weekly product funnel watcher
why: Finds the funnel step that lost the most each week, for the conversion part of a sales-change check.

name: Monthly repeat buyer keeper
why: Monthly repeat-purchase health from the order export, with the one stage to fix.

name: Repeat order bottleneck finder
why: One-off version of the repeat check: where customers stop coming back.

name: Best and worst customer profiler
why: Profiles the best and worst buyers from orders and discounts, to sharpen RFM segment actions.

name: Store LTV and payback reader
why: Reads first-order cohorts for repeat rate, lifetime value and payback on acquisition cost.

name: Daily contribution margin tracker
why: A daily contribution margin sheet with a returns accrual, the daily version of the margin layers in this kit.

name: Monthly returns and refunds reviewer
why: Monthly look at which products drive refunds, why, and what returns cost.

name: Discount impact checker
why: Checks what a discount does to margin before a promotion, alongside the margin and returns check.

name: Google Ads purchase tracking checker
why: Catches double-counted purchase conversions that inflate channel tables.
